                insideBrackets = true;
            }

                    countNoInside++;
                    wordSize = 0;
                }
            }
            if (c == '_') {

                    countNoInside++;

                    countMax = Math.max(countMax, wordSize);
                }
                wordSize = 0;
            }
        }
        countMax = Math.max(countMax, wordSize);
        System.out.println(countMax + " " + countNoInside);
    }
